description: Book a rental vehicle from a search result. Requires a Gondola account and a saved payment method (use get_payment_methods to find the payment ID). The vendor_code, rate_code, acriss_code, and search_id all come from search_vehicles results.

acriss_code.description: ACRISS vehicle classification code from search results.

loyalty_account_id.description: Optional loyalty account ID to earn points on this rental.

phone_number.description: Renter's phone number with country code (e.g. "+1-555-123-4567").

pickup_location.description: Optional pickup airport IATA code of the selected vehicle. Pass through whatever pickup_location the search returned for this vehicle to disambiguate metro fanouts (e.g. JFK vs LGA in NYC).

rate_code.description: Rate code of the selected vehicle from search results.

vendor_code.description: Vendor code from search results (e.g. "ZE" for Hertz).

name: book_vehicle
